big_case.notes: Damages-only challenge to rescinded 2021 Oregon/employer COVID-19 vaccination requirements, decided below in an unpublished memorandum applying circuit precedent the Court had already declined to review (Curtis v. Inslee, cert. denied June 1, 2026). No circuit split; the QP's investigational-drug/waiver framing was not the ground decided below, and state-action and qualified-immunity questions sit in front of it. Politically salient subject matter, but low legal stakes for this vehicle; denied without noted dissent.
